themes.summary: SpaceX (Nasdaq: SPCX) exercised a call option to buy Cursor for $60b in shares -- likely the largest-ever acquisition of a VC-backed startup outside Musk self-deals -- while SpaceX's market cap topped Amazon and briefly Microsoft; Sequoia's Roelof Botha joined the SpaceX board the same week.

Fox Corp. agreed to buy Roku for ~$22b (BFD) days after DOJ approved Paramount Skydance's $111b Warner Bros. Discovery takeover (still needs EU approval); both deals fold distribution and content further together.

themes.theme: PE's uneven track record with restaurant chains
themes.summary: LongRange Capital agreed to buy Pizza Hut's non-China ops from Yum! Brands for $1.5b (+ up to $75m earnouts), with Yum China buying the rest for $1.2b ($2.7b total); Wednesday's Top of the Morning catalogued PE's rocky history with pizza chains (California Pizza Kitchen, Sbarro, Round Table, Blaze, MOD, Domino's, Pizza Hut franchisees), most of which cycled through bankruptcy.

themes.theme: AI capital keeps flowing despite political backlash brewing
themes.summary: DeepSeek raised $7.5b at >$50b valuation, Kling AI in talks for $2b at $18b, Sarvam raised $234m at $1.5b, CuspAI raised $400m -- even as Sen. Bernie Sanders unveiled a plan for the U.S. government to take 50% equity stakes in large AI companies, and Sen. Elizabeth Warren pressed BlackRock, Blackstone, Brookfield and KKR on data-center/utility ownership overlaps.

PayPal Ventures (BFD) is shutting down and may sell its portfolio (Anchorage Digital, Divvy, Plaid stakes) on the secondary market as new CEO Enrique Lores simplifies the business -- a sign of continued corporate-VC pullback.

themes.theme: AI talent wars ahead of dueling IPOs
themes.summary: Noam Shazeer left Google for OpenAI, two years after Google paid $2.7b to acquire his team at CharacterAI (BFD) -- illustrating the limits of acqui-hire retention as OpenAI and Anthropic prep competing IPOs with separate Goldman Sachs/Morgan Stanley banker teams.
